method: POST https://tts.us.assemblyai.com/v1/speech, stream=false, container=wav, encoding=pcm_s16le, sample_rate=24000, one call per take, each voice's own greeting in its own Locale
measuredWith: src/lib/audio/level-facts.ts (BS.1770-4 gated integrated loudness, 4x true peak)
decision: output.volume = 100 for every measured voice: its own measured reference is the level target, and 100 is the native (unprocessed) level. output.volume attenuates only, so no voice is boosted; no measured voice is louder than the reference floor beyond the gate's 0.20 LU tolerance and no take clips (every true peak below 0 dBTP), so none needs attenuation. An unmeasured voice keeps the named default 100.
